modern: The ruling principle is that which rouses and turns itself, and while it makes itself such as it is and such as it wishes to be, it also makes everything which happens appear to itself to be such as it wishes.
original: The ruling principle is that which rouses and turns itself, and while it makes itself such as it is and such as it wills to be, it also makes everything which happens appear to itself to be such as it wills.
